description: How trackUsage / track_usage must treat each server answer to POST /v1/client-usage-event. Usage is best effort, never persisted and never retried: the call returns true only for a 2xx answer and never throws on a server or transport failure. SDKs without a result (.NET) must absorb every answer silently and send exactly once. Applies on Linux, Windows and macOS only. Usage is HTTPS-only, so an SDK test without a TLS server (Rust) can exercise only the transport failure.

cases.name: unknown package or usage events switched off
